policy.source: 118 retained original Train previews; 104 fixed face ROIs
policy.target: P01-P04 calibration only, 42 images; no P05 or classifier results
policy.reference: Untransformed Source Train, equal class/person weights
policy.screen_rank: Mean per-metric relative gaps, then worst; not a similarity percentage
policy.acceptance: All eight gaps nonincreasing vs raw Source, at least one decreasing
policy.per_seed_guard: All eight gaps nonincreasing for each of three replay seeds
policy.geometry: Identity only; framing/person/disease are not camera calibration
policy.limits_meaning: Declared engineering guards, not clinical preservation thresholds

limitations: Bounded beam search, not proof of a global optimum or impossibility
Four people/phones confound device and person; unlabeled healthy/disease mix differs
No geometry/content/noise/compression matching; no clinical preservation proof
Three replay seeds are repeated transforms, not independent people or training seeds
No refit on P05, Source Validation/Test or classifier accuracy
